lead_raw_text:
The structure of EuCoGe crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 15), with a unit cell containing six atoms—two Eu, two Co, and two Ge—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 14 neighbors (6 Eu, 2 Co, 6 Ge), Eu centers with 12 Ge neighbors, and Ge centers with 10 neighbors (4 Co, 3 Eu, 3 Ge). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner and face sharing between Co and Ge polyhedra, and between Co and Eu polyhedra.
